name: Claude Code with Config
description: Configures Claude Code with host-side configuration for seamless authentication. Depends on the official Claude Code Feature.
postCreateCommand: if [ ! -e "$HOME/.claude" ]; then ln -s /claude_config "$HOME/.claude"; fi; echo "alias claude='claude --mcp-path ~/.claude/mcp.json'" >> ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; echo "alias claude='claude --mcp-path ~/.claude/mcp.json'" >> ~/.zshrc 2>/dev/null || true
